resources.string: Stroke thickness of key labels, 400 is regular, 700 is bold. Requires Android 9.
Antialias text, icons and borders. Off keeps the keyboard pure black and white, which looks crisper in fast refresh modes.
Fill the key while it is held. When off, only vibration confirms a press.
Draw emoji in the keyboard with a monochrome font. Emoji missing from it are converted to black and white. Inserted emoji still appear in color in the app.

Russian dictionary: Leipzig Corpora Collection (wortschatz.uni-leipzig.de), CC BY 4.0, built by the HeliBoard dictionaries project. Black and white emoji: Noto Emoji by Google, SIL Open Font License 1.1.
